name: Quarteira
mandate: PrompTugal.news Quarteira: AI and technology in Quarteira, a beach and golf city whose parish holds Vilamoura, and what reaches Quarteira from Loulé, the Algarve, Portugal and the world. Independent; every fact sourced.

gravity.text: Quarteira is a coastal city and civil parish in the municipality of Loulé, a fishing village that became a city in 1999. Its economy leans on tourism and golf, and its parish holds Vilamoura, described as Europe's largest private tourist development. Decisions that touch its technology, from urban planning to the Quarteira Lab sensors, are taken by the Loulé council.

ai_news.title: Loulé council says it has already bought AI tools to speed up planning permits
ai_news.summary: At a meeting with hundreds of planning professionals, the Loulé council announced AI tools among other measures to cut licensing delays. The mayor said technology alone will not fix the problem while internal bureaucratic obstacles remain. The article does not name the tools or the supplier.
ai_news.ai_path: The council that governs Quarteira has contracted AI tools to process planning files, so permits in Quarteira are handled with AI support.

ai_news.title: Loulé is installing 60 cameras around Vilamoura's hotel ring, extension to Quarteira planned; no AI stated
ai_news.summary: After a June 2026 meeting with merchants, GNR and civil protection, the Loulé council said it is installing 60 video-surveillance cameras on the hotel ring in Vilamoura, besides those at the marina, with extension planned to Almancil, Quarteira and Loulé. A municipal police force is also being set up. The article does not say whether the system analyses images automatically.
ai_news.ai_path: Camera networks are the usual place where automatic image analysis is added later, so this is a watch item. No AI is claimed by the source.

ai_news.title: EU funds to bring AI and robotics to 15 Algarve tourism firms
ai_news.summary: The regional tourism platform run by CCDR Algarve heard that an ALGARVE 2030 project will give 15 tourism SMEs a digital maturity check and a personal action plan to adopt AI and robotics. Algarve Evolution's president advised firms to prepare their digital channels for agentic AI that searches and books on behalf of travellers. The article names no town and gives no eligibility rules.
ai_news.ai_path: Quarteira and Vilamoura live on tourism and golf, so any of its hotels or operators that join this regional AI programme, or that prepare for AI booking agents, would use AI. The article does not say who was selected.

ai_news.title: Old Course Vilamoura adds Trackman ball tracking, first in the Algarve
ai_news.summary: The Old Course and the Els Club in Vilamoura joined Trackman's virtual golf platform, with ball-tracking for the range, coaching, fitting and indoor simulator rounds. The partnership was facilitated by DETAILS, which manages Arrow Global's hospitality and golf assets. The article mentions no AI, only the accuracy of the data. Kept as context from Vilamoura.
ai_news.ai_path: Radar sensors turn every shot into data, the raw material of analytics and coaching models. No AI is claimed by the source.

ai_news.title: Quarteira Lab counts walkers and cyclists to feed a data platform
ai_news.summary: As part of the Quarteira Lab decarbonisation project run by the Loulé council, a counter for people and bicycles was installed at a junction on Avenida Dr. Carlos Mota Pinto. The data goes to an aggregating platform and is meant to reach digital panels and a mobile app. The article mentions no AI. This is an older item kept for context.
ai_news.ai_path: Street sensors feed a data platform, and such platforms are what analytics and AI models are trained and run on. No AI is claimed by the project.

voice.lede: Quarteira: where the sardines retired, the golf balls arrived, and the robots are still queuing at the beach bar.
voice.mandate: PrompTugal.news Quarteira, pá: we follow the AI and the gadgets from this sunny city and its big-resort neighbour Vilamoura, and whatever drifts in from Loulé, the Algarve and the world. Independent, and every fact has its receipt.
voice.gravity: Quarteira was a proper fishing village once and became a city in 1999, bem chique. Now it lives on sun, sea and golf, with Vilamoura next door in the same parish. When it comes to gadgets, the grown-ups at Loulé's câmara hold the keys, from planning permits to the Quarteira Lab sensors.
